global_policies.label: Anti-Double-Charge / Non-Additive Minimum
global_policies.formula: FINAL_PRICE = max(MINIMUM, STANDARD_SERVICE_PRICE). NEVER minimum + service.
global_policies.canonical_rule: Minimum is a floor, not an additional charge.
global_policies.status: CONSISTENT — all métiers with explicit minimum use this rule
global_policies.variations: None found. All four métiers define the same anti-stack rule.
global_policies.anti_additive_rule: NOT_ADDITIVE — MINIMUM IS FLOOR NOT ADDITIVE
global_policies.canonical_formula: FINAL_PRICE = max(MINIMUM, SERVICE_PRICE). NOT_ADDITIVE. NOT: MINIMUM + SERVICE_PRICE.

global_policies.label: Hors Périmètre Prix FIXEO — Escape Workflow

electricite: MAKE_SAFE — cut power, verify isolation BEFORE any scope declaration or continuation
serrurerie: AUTHORIZATION_CHECK — verify occupancy right before unlock if no key presented
climatisation: REFRIGERATION_INTEGRITY — if leak found, stop recharge, issue leak-first quote

global_policies.status: CONSISTENT base workflow — metier-specific safety steps correctly preserved
global_policies.note: Electrical MAKE_SAFE must come FIRST even before IDENTIFY — artisan safety overrides workflow order

global_policies.label: Hardware / Part Disclosure Sequence
global_policies.prohibition: Silent hardware bundling PROHIBITED. Silent markup PROHIBITED.
global_policies.note: Plomberie and menuiserie have 'client supplies main part' (robinet/door leaf) which is a variant of CLIENT_SUPPLIED_PART model

global_policies.label: Diagnostic Fee Absorption Rule
global_policies.rule: Diagnostic fee absorbed into intervention price if client accepts qualifying standardized same-visit repair
global_policies.absorption_policy: D3 — absorbed for standardized qualifying services; standalone otherwise
global_policies.standalone_trigger: no repair / inconclusive / out of scope / specialist needed / utility equipment
global_policies.status: CONSISTENT RULE — prices differ by métier (justified by tool burden)

variations.serrurerie: No explicit diagnostic service — serrurerie assessment is part of opening/replacement service
variations.bricolage: No diagnostic — scope is assessed on booking via pre-screening
variations.nettoyage: No diagnostic — scope assessed via surface area and property type
variations.peinture: No diagnostic — scope assessed via m² and surface condition questions
variations.menuiserie: No standalone diagnostic — minimum floor (300 MAD) covers assessment cost on repair visits

global_policies.label: Electrical Safety Override
global_policies.canonical_rule: MAKE_SAFE before any work proceeds. Artisan who bypasses safety to stay within fixed price acts outside FIXEO standards and assumes full personal liability.
global_policies.onee_boundary: Disjoncteur de branchement (limiteur de puissance) = ONEE property. NEVER FIXEO scope. Redirect to ONEE (0801 00 20 20).
global_policies.earth_ground_matrix: 6-condition policy (present+connected / disconnected / absent / damaged / legacy 2-wire / incorrectly bonded) — each has defined action including SAFETY_OVERRIDE conditions
global_policies.status: UNIQUE TO ELECTRICITE — do not apply to other métiers

global_policies.label: Refrigeration Integrity
global_policies.rule: If leak found during recharge: STOP recharge, issue LEAK-FIRST quote. Blind top-up without leak check PROHIBITED.
global_policies.r22_rule: R22 systems (pre-2020): artisan must inform client R22 is being phased out. No blind R22 top-up.
global_policies.r32_rule: R32 systems: flammable refrigerant — requires specialist certification. Standard FIXEO scope only for R410A unless artisan is certified for R32.
global_policies.vacuum_requirement: Vacuum required before any recharge. No shortcuts.

global_policies.label: Serrurerie Occupancy Authorization
global_policies.rule: Before any lockout opening: artisan must verify occupancy right. Proof of residence or ID required when no key presented and circumstance is ambiguous.
global_policies.vehicle_safe: Vehicle and safe access require additional authorization verification and may require attestation.

global_policies.label: Painted Surface Conversion
global_policies.rule: Floor area (m²) ≠ Painted surface (m²). Conversion required. Current conversion model = RESEARCH_ESTIMATION_ONLY.
global_policies.conversion_model_status: NOT APPROVED — do not use in production estimator yet
global_policies.ceiling_rule: Ceiling m² is measured directly from ceiling dimensions — NOT converted from floor area.
global_policies.do_not_collapse: PER_PAINTED_M2 ≠ PER_CEILING_M2 ≠ PER_M2 (nettoyage). Three distinct measurement bases.
global_policies.status: UNIQUE TO PEINTURE — no other métier needs painted-surface conversion

global_policies.label: Cleaner-Hour Team Scaling
global_policies.rule: TOTAL = rate_per_cleaner_per_hour × worker_count × hours. Worker count is explicit input from client.
global_policies.minimum_floor: max(200 MAD, total). NET-001 floor applies.
global_policies.do_not_confuse_with_bricolage: Bricolage PER_HOUR is single-worker only. NEVER apply cleaner-team logic to bricolage.

global_policies.label: FIXEO Dual Fairness Principle
global_policies.canonical_statement: A FIXEO price is acceptable only if it simultaneously protects the client from arbitrary overpricing AND the artisan from economically unsustainable underpricing. FIXEO must NOT target the cheapest market price.
global_policies.status: CONSISTENT — all 8 métiers use this principle
corollaries: Artisan economic floor is a client-quality guarantee — artisan who cannot cover travel and tools will not serve clients well
A client who receives a hidden hardware charge has been deceived
A client who discovers fabrication scope on-site must be quoted and allowed to decline
